name: CMN Synapse
synopsis: The reference CMN indexer — ingests signed manifests, indexes spores and myceliums, serves discovery queries, and syncs across instances via Nostr.
intent: Deliver a federated indexer implementing the Synapse protocol with verifiable ingestion and synchronization: HTTP/HTTPS serving, certificate automation, signed pulse processing, background crawling, relay-based cross-instance sync, and optional vector/graph query acceleration
Enable decentralized spore discovery — anyone can run a Synapse instance, index spores from any domain, and be queried by hypha or any CMN-aware agent

bonds.reason: Deployed HTTP service — declares base URLs in service.json and provides GET /health
Implements the Synapse protocol — pulse ingestion, spore retrieval, lineage traversal, mycelium listing
Implements full-text search across indexed spores when search feature is enabled
Implements Nostr relay and pulse forwarding when nostr feature is enabled
All API response fields and log events use Agent-First Data suffix conventions
Implements the CMN protocol specification — reference Synapse indexer
